additional_info.subject: RE: 0385807 - ID0385807-DC/Si-D/JO- [MP / R4 170001885] Authentication not possible CRM:02023000231
additional_info.body:
Dear Sadek,
Thank you for your patience.
To assist you more effectively, could you please provide the serial number of the charger connected to the same backend?
Regarding ticket ID 0380042, we had previously provided recommendations on time intervals. However, upon reviewing the logs for charger IDs Yiqghh and lj1Ik3, we noted that no changes were made to lj1Ik3 following our advice.
On October 19, 2024, at 8:45 AM Jordan Local Time, we detected an attempt to change the configuration, which was rejected, causing the charger to temporarily go offline. It reconnected within 30 seconds and sent a status notification. The charger then experienced a configuration change loop for approximately 15-20 minutes, likely contributing to the OCPP toggling issues.
To enhance stability, we recommend asking your OCPP backend provider to adjust the following parameters:
HeartbeatInterval: Decrease to 180 seconds
WebSocketPingInterval: Decrease to 60 seconds
Please note that the backend is not integrated with the Sicharge D. While Sicharge D complies with the OCPP 1.6J standard and was able to establish a connection with the OCPP server, this does not guarantee that all operations or functionalities will work seamlessly.
If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, please feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
